metadata.title: Origin of the S Stars in the Galactic Center

notes: No eligible star. The only individually named star, S2 (T:p1-b7), is a Galactic-center S star discussed as a bound star whose orbital orientation may be affected by Lense-Thirring precession; the paper does not identify it as a Galactic unbound candidate. Hypervelocity stars in the Galactic halo are mentioned only generically (T:p1-b3, T:p3-b10), with no observed star named or individually assessed as an unbound candidate. The ejected stars in the simulations are not identifiable observed stars.
